title: 12 Best Drink Polish craft ales and lagers in the vibrant bars surrounding Wrocław's historic Rynek square.
description: Explore Wrocław's best craft beer bars around Rynek Square in 2026. Discover top Polish ales and lagers at Kontynuacja, PINTA Wrocław, and more. Find prices, tips, and what to order for an unforgettable experience.
category: Drink Polish craft ales and lagers

places.name: Kontynuacja
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ask the staff for their current seasonal IPA or a dark lager from a local Wrocław brewery.

places.name: PINTA Wrocław - Browar i Restauracja
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try their classic 'A Ja Pale Ale' or one of their experimental barrel-aged stouts, paired with pierogi.

places.name: AleBrowar Wrocław
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'Rowing Jack' IPA is a classic, or try their 'Hop Sasa' for a refreshing twist. Pair it with one of their juicy burgers.

places.name: Zakład Usług Piwnych ZUP
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Opt for a unique sour beer or a strong stout from one of the smaller, emerging Polish breweries on their menu.

places.name: Concept Stu Mostów
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'Salamander Pale Ale' is a staple, but don't miss their 'ART' series for more experimental brews. Pair with their artisanal cheese board.

places.name: Craft Bier Cafe
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ask for a recommendation based on your preferred style, or try a unique Polish wheat beer (Pszeniczne).

places.name: 4Hops (Four Hops)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their New England IPAs are frequently praised, or try a crisp Grodziskie for a taste of traditional Polish smoked wheat beer.

places.name: Szynkarnia - Miłe Miejsce
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their traditional Polish 'żurek' (sour rye soup) with a rich porter or a flavorful amber ale.

places.name: Marynka Piwo i Aperitivo
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A refreshing Polish lager or a fruited sour, accompanied by their exquisite 'aperitivo platter' with cured meats and cheeses.

places.name: Targ Piwny - Beer Store & Pub
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try a flight of smaller pours to sample a wider range of Polish craft styles, then grab a few bottles of your favorites to go.

places.name: Drugie Dno Craft Beer & Food
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their selection of juicy IPAs is usually strong, or try one of their inventive Polish stouts. Pair with their loaded fries.

places.name: Wratislavia
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try their house-brewed lager for a crisp, refreshing taste, or their dark 'Koźlak' (Bock) for something richer.

tags: Drink Polish craft ales and lagers
